parameters.name: Grpc
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable gRPC. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:
- on: enabled
- off: disabled.

parameters.name: Http2Origin
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2 back-to-origin. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:
- on: enabled
- off: disabled.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: enabled.
- off: disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version on which the configuration takes effect. The default value is 0.

parameters.name: SmartRouting
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable smart routing. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:
- on: enabled
- off: disabled.

parameters.name: UploadMaxFilesize
parameters.description: The maximum upload file size, in MB. Valid values: 100 to 500.

parameters.name: Websocket
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable WebSocket. This feature is enabled by default. Valid values:
- on: enabled
- off: disabled.
